title: My Uncle the Pilot
description: A girl tells us about her uncle, who is a pilot.
instructions: Read about Uncle Tom and his job. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🛫 My uncle Tom is a pilot. He flies big planes for an airline and travels to many countries. I am very proud of him, and I want to be a pilot too.
Uncle Tom's job is not easy. He has to get up at four o'clock in the morning when he has an early flight. Before every flight, he checks the plane and looks at the weather with the other pilots.

Last month, I visited Uncle Tom at the airport. He showed me the cockpit, which is the small room where the pilots sit. There were hundreds of buttons! I sat in his chair and held the wheel. It was very exciting.
Uncle Tom told me that pilots must be good at English, because they talk to people from many countries. They also have to stay calm if something goes wrong. 'A good pilot never gets afraid,' he said.
My uncle likes his job, but it is hard to be away from home. Sometimes he misses my birthday party. Last year, he was working in Japan on my birthday, so he sent me a lovely card and a toy robot.
When he is at home, he loves cooking for the family. His favourite food is noodle soup, which my grandmother taught him to make. If you visit us on Sunday, you can try it!

Next year, I am going to join a flying club for children. Uncle Tom says that I should study maths and science at school. 'If you work hard, you will fly a plane one day,' he told me. I will never forget his words.
